Error.description: Campus error envelope (see ErrorEnvelope); malformed or invalid fields use the ValidationError shape (422, with error.errors). Possible statuses: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 429, 500, 503.

code.description: Campus error code (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE; AUTH_* for OAuth protocol errors, RFC 6749 §5.2)

details.description: Additional error details, including OAuth protocol fields (error, error_description)

errors.description: Field-level validation errors; present on the 422 ValidationError shape only

code.description: Machine-readable field error code, e.g. MISSING, INVALID_TYPE, UNRECOGNIZED_FIELD

info.description:
Observability backend for Campus: trace/span ingestion, querying, journey grouping, and audit API-key management.

The /audit/v1 endpoints require Bearer authentication with an audit API key (audit_v1_<22-char-base64url>). The audit web UI lives in the campus-admin portal, which consumes this API with its own key; this service redirects the UI's old page URLs there (AUDIT_UI_URL).

## Trailing slashes

Paths are listed exactly as routed (Flask): a path shown with a trailing slash must be requested with it — the no-slash variant answers with a 308 redirect.
info.title: Campus Audit API

get.summary: Send old UI URLs to the portal (or explain where it moved).

get.description:
The plan delta and history the campus-admin Migrations view
renders (#1172): the compute_status diff, per-file approval
metadata (sha256, declared rollback support, docstring
summary) for every pending revision, the full ledger history
(who/when/duration/hash/error per the #746 execution audit),
and whether an apply is in flight.

GET /admin/migrations/
Authorization: a principal holding the 'migrations:read'
scope for this service (#1168: grant rows are instance-scoped
by resource_id naming the service DB).

Returns: {
    "service": <db>,
    "status": [{revision, filename, state}, ...],
    "plan": [{revision, filename, hash, rollback, summary}, ...],
    "history": [{revision, filename, status, applied_at,
                 applied_by, duration_ms, error, file_hash}, ...],
    "running": bool
}

Responses:
    200 OK: dict — the body above.
    403 Forbidden: dict — the caller fails the migrations
        gate for this service.
get.summary: Migration plan and ledger status for this service

post.description:
Sets the apply's cooperative cancel event (#1166): the hook
is checked between migrations, so the in-flight migration
finishes atomically and the remaining revisions stay pending
(the next apply resumes them). 409 when nothing is running.

POST /admin/migrations/abort
Authorization: a principal holding 'migrations:write' for
this service (#1168).

Returns: {"aborting": true}

Responses:
    200 OK: dict — the cancel event is set.
    403 Forbidden: dict — the caller fails the migrations
        gate for this service.
    409 Conflict: dict — no apply is running for this
        service.

Starts the runner's apply for this service's scope in a
background thread and returns immediately: one POST per
staged window, progress lands in the service log and the
ledger, and GET /admin/migrations/ polls `running`/`history`.
The runner's advisory lock (#1166) guards other workers; an
in-process second apply (or a rollback) gets 409. Cancel
between migrations via POST /admin/migrations/abort.

POST /admin/migrations/apply
Authorization: a principal holding 'migrations:write' for
this service (#1168).

Body: {
    "up_to": "008"  (optional — apply only revisions at or
                    below this one; staged windows)
}

Returns: {"started": true, "service": <db>}

Responses:
    202 Accepted: dict — the apply thread started.
    400 Bad Request: dict — unknown `up_to` revision.
    403 Forbidden: dict — the caller fails the migrations
        gate for this service.
    409 Conflict: dict — an apply is already running in this
        worker.

Delegates to the runner's rollback (#1170): migrations
declaring ROLLBACK_SUPPORTED='ddl' run their downgrade();
'backup' migrations restore the envelope named by
`from_backup` (a local path or a bucket://<name>/<key> URI —
the apply's fail-closed backup upload is where the URI comes
from). Undeclared revisions, hash-guarded files and held
advisory locks are refused by the runner; on any failure the
ledger row stays applied. Refused with 409 while an apply is
in flight.

POST /admin/migrations/rollback
Authorization: a principal holding 'migrations:admin' for
this service (#1168 — the destructive cap, granted
sparingly).

Body: {
    "revision": "007",
    "from_backup": "bucket://campus-backups/migrations/005/..."
                   (required for backup-restoration
                   migrations)
}

Returns: {"rolled_back": <revision>}

Responses:
    200 OK: dict — the revision is pending again.
    400 Bad Request: dict — unknown revision (or a backup
        rollback invoked without from_backup).
    403 Forbidden: dict — the caller fails the migrations
        gate for this service.
    409 Conflict: dict — the revision is not applied, cannot
        be rolled back, is hash-guarded, a run holds the
        advisory lock, or an apply is in flight in this
        worker; the message carries the runner's error text.

get.description:
Query params:
    owner_id: Filter by owner ID (optional)
    active_only: Only show active (non-expired, non-revoked) keys (default: true)
    limit: int, default 50

Returns:
    List of API key summaries (excluding key_hash)
get.summary: List API keys with optional filtering.

post.description:
Request body:
{
  "name": "string",
  "owner_id": "string",
  "scopes": ["scope1", "scope2"],  // optional
  "role": "traces-viewer",  // optional, a named role (#918)
  "rate_limit": 100,  // optional, requests per minute
  "expires_at": "ISO 8601",  // optional
  "trace_user_id": "string",  // optional, trace-read bind (#944)
  "trace_client_id": "string"  // optional, trace-read bind (#944)
}

Give either a role or a list of scopes, not both: a role is a named
bundle of scopes from the catalogue (campus_python.audit.roles), and
naming both leaves it ambiguous which one was meant.

Trace-read scoping (#944): trace_user_id/trace_client_id are
opaque bind values the service enforces server-side on every
traces:read surface (plain string equality against span identity
attributes; campus.audit never resolves them against campus.auth).
A mint that grants trace reads without apikeys:write (admin
class) or traces:write (producer pipeline) must carry at least
one bind — fail-closed, so a per-student key can never be minted
globally-readable by accident. Admin/producer keys omit the binds
and read unscoped. Binds are mint-time only; PATCH does not
accept them.

Returns:
    201 Created with the API key (only shown once) and key details
    422 Unprocessable Entity on invalid input

delete.description:
This marks the API key as revoked. It will no longer work for
authentication, but the record is kept for audit purposes.

Args:
    api_key_id: The API key identifier

Returns:
    204 No Content on success
    404 Not Found if API key doesn't exist

get.description:
Args:
    api_key_id: The API key identifier

Returns:
    Full API key details (excluding key_hash)
get.summary: Get a specific API key by ID.

patch.description:
Only name, scopes, and rate_limit can be updated.
Use DELETE to revoke an API key.

Args:
    api_key_id: The API key identifier

Request body:
{
  "name": "new name",  // optional
  "scopes": ["scope1", "scope2"],  // optional
  "role": "traces-viewer",  // optional, a named role (#918)
  "rate_limit": 200  // optional
}

Give either a role or a list of scopes, not both: a role is a named
bundle of scopes from the catalogue (campus_python.audit.roles), and
naming both leaves it ambiguous which one was meant.

Returns:
    200 OK with updated API key details
    404 Not Found if API key doesn't exist
    422 Unprocessable Entity on invalid input
patch.summary: Update mutable fields of an API key.

post.description:
Creates a new plaintext API key value while keeping the same ID.
The old key will no longer work after regeneration. The new key
is returned in the response and will not be shown again.

Args:
    api_key_id: The API key identifier

Returns:
    200 OK with the new API key (shown only once) and updated details
    404 Not Found if API key doesn't exist
post.summary: Regenerate an API key with a new value.

get.description:
The calling key's trace bind (#944) is applied before counting, so
a scoped key's trace_count only counts traces it may see.

Args:
    journey_id: The journey tag carried on the member spans

Returns:
    {"journey_id": ..., "trace_count": N, "traces": [...]} — the
    same envelope the web UI's journey view renders. An unknown or
    empty journey is a 200 with trace_count 0, not a 404: the id
    is a tag, not a stored resource.
get.summary: List the member traces of one journey, oldest first.

get.description:
Query params:
    since: ISO 8601 timestamp (optional)
    until: ISO 8601 timestamp (optional)
    limit: page size, clamped to [1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE] (default
        DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)
    cursor: opaque token from a previous page's cursor.next

Supports content negotiation via Accept header:
    - application/json: Structured JSON with cursor pagination
    - text/plain: Compact human-readable text

Returns:
    JSON: {"traces": [...], "cursor": {"next": "...", "has_more": true}}
    Text: Compact trace list with pagination hint

post.description:
Accepts a single span or batch of spans. Returns 201 Created on full
success, or 207 Multi-Status on partial failure with per-span status
indicators.

Request body:
{
  "spans": [
    {
      "trace_id": "string",
      "span_id": "string",
      "parent_span_id": "string | null",
      "method": "string",
      "path": "string",
      "status_code": 200,
      "started_at": "ISO 8601",
      "duration_ms": 142.5,
      "query_params": {},
      "request_headers": {},
      "request_body": null,
      "response_headers": {},
      "response_body": null,
      "client_id": "string | null",
      "user_id": "string | null",
      "api_key_id": "string",
      "client_ip": "string",
      "user_agent": "string",
      "error_message": "string | null",
      "tags": {}
    }
  ]
}

Returns:
    201 Created with span IDs on success
    207 Multi-Status on partial failure
    400 Bad Request on invalid input
    429 Too Many Requests when a rate-limit bucket is exceeded
        (#831); the response carries Retry-After and the tripped
        bucket key in the error details

Note:
    campus.audit stamps each stored span itself. ``tags.producer_id``
    is the API key that made this request (#1244), and
    ``tags.queue_ms`` is the wait between the request's arrival
    (``X-Request-Start``) and the span's ``started_at``. A producer
    supplying either tag has its value replaced.

    A successful ingest writes no audit event: the spans are the
    record. A rejected one (400 or 429) writes ``audit.traces.ingest``
    with the batch it refused, kept to the first 64 KB (#1243).

get.description:
Query params:
    path: Filter by endpoint path
    status: Filter by HTTP status code
    api_key_id: Filter by API key
    client_id: Filter by OAuth client
    user_id: Filter by user
    journey_id: Filter by login-journey tag (#803)
    since: ISO 8601 timestamp (optional)
    until: ISO 8601 timestamp (optional)
    limit: page size, clamped to [1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE] (default
        DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)
    cursor: opaque token from a previous page's cursor.next
    events: include audit-event traces (spans tagged with an
        event_type, #941). Default is to include them, as this
        endpoint always has; callers that want the viewer's
        request-only list (event trails are noise when debugging a
        real flow) pass events=false. true/1 and false/0 are the
        accepted literals; anything else is a field error.

Supports content negotiation via Accept header.

Returns:
    Filtered trace list matching criteria with cursor pagination

Args:
    trace_id: The 32-char hex trace identifier

Supports content negotiation via Accept header:
    - application/json: Nested tree structure with children arrays
    - text/plain: Waterfall with offset timing

Returns:
    JSON: {"trace_id": ..., "root_span": <trace tree with nested children>}
    Text: Waterfall visualization showing timing hierarchy
get.summary: Get full trace tree with child spans.
